name: Dancing for Marzipan
summary: During Hallow's End, travelers in Darnassus gather sweets for Jesper, a sick orphan in Stormwind. Innkeeper Saelienne keeps the trick-or-treat custom: a dance comes before her Darnassus Marzipan.

sections.title: A Tradition Upheld
sections.body: Hallow's End brings a lighter spirit to Darnassus, the sacred forest city of the long-lived night elves. You come seeking sweets for Jesper, a sick child recovering in Stormwind. Innkeeper Saelienne keeps the season's custom, even when the treat is meant for a child in need. First, she asks for a trick.

sections.title: The Price of Marzipan
sections.body: Saelienne asks you to dance on the inn floor before she gives you Darnassus Marzipan. The performance earns the sweet needed for the holiday care package bound for Jesper.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Dancing for Marzipan?
faq.answer: Dancing for Marzipan lets you earn Darnassus Marzipan from Innkeeper Saelienne in Darnassus. The sweet is one of several Hallow's End treats gathered to cheer Jesper, a sick orphan in Stormwind.

Innkeeper Saelienne manages an inn in Darnassus, where travelers find shelter and rest beneath Teldrassil's boughs. During Hallow's End, she gives local sweets to those who take part in the tradition.

faq.q: Why does Saelienne insist on a dance?
aliases: why does saelienne want me to dance
faq.answer: Saelienne follows Hallow's End's trick-or-treat custom. She asks for a dance before giving you a sweet intended for an ailing child.

faq.q: Where does the marzipan go after this?
faq.answer: The Darnassus Marzipan joins seasonal sweets from inns in Ironforge and Stormwind, along with sweets from Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge. Together, they are meant to bring holiday joy to young Jesper in Stormwind.

aliases: what kind of candy is it
faq.answer: Darnassus Marzipan is a sugary confection made in the night elven capital. It is the city's festive treat for Hallow's End visitors.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this quest?
faq.answer: No. Dancing for Marzipan is for Alliance characters. Darnassus is an Alliance stronghold, and the marzipan is gathered for an Alliance orphan recovering in Stormwind City.

angles.text: For the Alliance, this Hallow's End tradition brings sweets from distant Teldrassil to a young orphan in Stormwind, shared across the capitals.
As a night elf, you take part in the Alliance's Hallow's End customs, joining playful revelry with your woodland way of life.
